symptoms: Rosetted flowers where petals are bound together with silky webs, failing to open properly
Entry holes on small green bolls plugged with excreta and sealed by the growing tissue
Immature bolls dropping; opened bolls showing double-seeds, discoloured stained lint, and internal seed feeding
lookalikes: Spotted bollworm (Earias vittella) - which bores into tender apical shoots causing wilting
favourable_conditions: Warm cloudy weather with 70-85% relative humidity
season_or_growth_stage: Squaring, flowering, and boll maturation (45 to 150 DAS)
monitoring_and_confirmation: Install Gossyplure pheromone traps @ 5 traps/acre at 45 DAS; Economic Threshold Level (ETL): 8 moths/trap/night for 3 consecutive days or 10% rosetted flowers
prevention: Terminating the crop before January; avoid ratoon cotton
Deep summer ploughing to expose hibernating pupae to solar heat
cultural_management: Synchronized community sowing across contiguous farm blocks
mechanical_management: Hand-pick and destroy rosetted flowers and fallen squares twice a week
biological_management: Release Trichogramma bactrae egg parasitoid @ 60,000/acre at weekly intervals starting 45 DAS

organic_options.treatment_name: Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) or Neem Oil (1500 PPM)
organic_options.timing: Early squaring stage as oviposition deterrent
limitations: Deters egg laying; does not kill larvae already inside closed bolls.

chemical_options.dilution: 9 to 10 g per 15-liter spray pump (90-100 g per acre in 150-200 L water)
chemical_options.timing: Spray when pheromone trap catches exceed ETL (8 moths/trap/night)
mixing_warnings: Do not mix with alkaline solutions or sulfur products.
chemical_options.safety_advisory: Verified against CIBRC label and ICAR/SAU package of practices. Follow standard PPE and PHI guidelines.

chemical_options.dilution: 6 to 7 ml per 15-liter spray pump (60 ml per acre in 150-200 L water)
chemical_options.timing: At early boll development upon exceeding ETL
mixing_warnings: Do not spray during peak midday heat. Avoid drift to water bodies.
chemical_options.safety_advisory: Verified against CIBRC label and ICAR/SAU package of practices. Follow standard PPE and PHI guidelines.

resistance_management: Rotate between diamides (Chlorantraniliprole), avermectins (Emamectin), and spinosyns. Never apply synthetic pyrethroids repeatedly.
expert_referral_conditions: Contact local KVK agronomist or Kisan Call Centre (1800-180-1551) if infestation exceeds threshold.
